thread:
Priya Sharma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. leadership wants a concise set of target windows for API/Console/Optimize so customer comms aren't vague. can owners + hard blockers be called out here?

Marco Valdez: summary draft: API runtime (streaming + chat improvements) canary mid-May; Console onboarding + flags beta mid-June; Optimize (cost suggestions + quant recommendations v0) alpha early July. these are targets and gated by quant infra & canary traffic profiles.

Alice Chen: note on Console: beta depends on per-org feature flags + admin controls. aiming to have flags + admin rollout UI by 2024-06-03 so we get a week of pilot flips before public beta.

Ben Ortiz: comms approach: ok to present as "target windows" in the webinar if we include the dependency note. i will not publish until canary is visibly active.

Dana Liu: SRE requirements: SLO definitions, canary traffic profiles, and acceptable error-burst thresholds must be finalized by 2024-05-03. if not, canary must shift. also need staging capacity numbers from eng-platform by 2024-04-29.

Evan Park: eng-platform request: please list expected qps, burst, and per-region replicas for the canary. i can reserve quota once owners confirm.

Sofia Rivas: Optimize alpha scope: suggestion engine + dashboard heatmap + offline quant recommendation hints. no billing plumbing or autoscale during alpha. we need 3 pilot customers to validate quality.

Marco Valdez: draft owners: Marco -> API runtime & canary hooks; Alice -> Console rollout and flags; Sofia -> Optimize suggestion models; Dana + Evan -> infra, SLO gating & staging quota; Ben -> external comms.

Priya Sharma: can owners confirm by EOD? i'll hold the public webinar slide until confirmed.

Alice Chen: confirmed for Console. will post a short feature-flag checklist in #eng-product by EOD.

Marco Valdez: confirmed for API. action: post compatibility tests + canary runbook in #eng-runtime by 2024-04-28.

Sofia Rivas: confirmed for Optimize. action: compile pilot customer ask and quality metrics we want (false-positive rate target, suggestion acceptance %) by 2024-05-06.

Dana Liu: SRE confirmed blockers: SLO doc + traffic profile owner needed. i can co-author SLOs with Marco; target to publish by 2024-05-01.

Evan Park: platform will post the staging capacity request template and expected GPU reservation lead times by EOD.

Ben Ortiz: comms plan: i'll draft slide language with qualifiers: "targets, dependent on infra & SLOs" and share for sign-off.

Marco Valdez: schedule snippet to pin here:
```
API runtime (streaming/chat): canary 2024-05-16 -> GA late May (target)
Console (flags + onboarding): flags ready 2024-06-03 -> beta 2024-06-10 -> GA 2024-06-24
Optimize (suggestions v0): internal alpha 2024-07-01 -> limited pilot 2024-07-08
```

deploy-bot: queued task: reserve staging GPUs for API canary 2024-05-01 04:00 UTC :robot_face:

Priya Sharma: thanks everyone. please drop any hard blockers or date pushes in this thread by EOD so i can finalize notes for leadership and the webinar.
